channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Dólar dispara 1% nesta sexta com investidores atentos com cenário eleitoral
item.description: The dollar surged over 1% in early trading on Friday, surpassing R$ 5, as investors focused on political developments surrounding presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Master Bank. The connection between the two has raised concerns about potential financial influence on the campaign, increasing market risk aversion. The volatility highlights the exchange rate’s sensitivity to political uncertainty ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 15 de maio
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on May 15, 2026 satirizes the relationship between Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, and Flávio Bolsonaro, implying political collusion or influence in the financial sector. The critical humor suggests possible influence peddling or illegitimate favoritism amid rising pre-election tensions in 2026.

item.title: Revelação sobre elo entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro causa 'desgaste muito grande', diz Kassab
item.description: PSD national president Gilberto Kassab says revelations linking Flávio Bolsonaro to jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro are causing 'very great wear' to the senator's campaign, after audio and text messages showed Flávio asking Vorcaro for money to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. Kassab states the trend is for Flávio Bolsonaro to drop in voter intention polls.

item.title: Flávio diz que recursos foram usados “integralmente” em filme
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the $24 million transferred by Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse' was fully used in production, denying Eduardo Bolsonaro received any funds. The Federal Police is investigating whether the money was used to support Eduardo in the U.S., but Flávio claims transparency due to SEC oversight of the Havengate fund and says he is a target of persecution and false narratives.

item.title: Flávio diz que gestor de fundo ligado a filme é advogado de Eduardo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the manager of the fund linked to the film 'Dark Horse' is the lawyer of his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, denying that Eduardo received financing from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. The Federal Police are investigating whether Vorcaro’s payments to the film were actually directed to Eduardo. Flávio said his brother survives in the U.S. with personal resources and denied any quid pro quo in his interactions with Vorcaro.

item.title: Após áudio de Vorcaro com Flávio Bolsonaro, André Mendonça marca reunião com a PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça scheduled a meeting with the Federal Police to discuss leaks in Operation Compliance Zero, following the release of audios between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro regarding financing of a biopic on Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio confirmed the contacts but denied any quid pro quo, calling it a private negotiation. Vorcaro, imprisoned, is negotiating a plea deal that could implicate officials from all three branches of government.

item.title: Calendário oficial ganha Julho Neon para conscientização sobre saúde bucal
item.description: July has been officially designated as Oral Health Awareness Month in Brazil, establishing 'Julho Neon' through Law 15.408/2026, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The law mandates nationwide educational campaigns and preventive actions throughout the month, aiming to reduce regional disparities in dental care access and promote oral hygiene habits. The initiative originated from Bill PL 2.563/2021 by Deputy Doutor Luizinho (PP-RR) and was approved following a favorable opinion by Senator Jussara Lima (PSD-PI).

item.title: JOTA Principal: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta se explicar de novo e reitera que dinheiro de Vorcaro ia só para filme
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated that the money transferred by Daniel Vorcaro was destined exclusively to a fund for the production of Jair Bolsonaro's biopic, denying any diversion to finance his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro or other purposes. He also denied having intimacy or discussing other matters with Vorcaro, stating their December 2024 meeting was solely for film sponsorship, while the PF investiges whether the funds were used to bankroll Eduardo Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai insistir no papel de quem esmola dinheiro de Vorcaro ou tomar outro caminho?
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro faces his first major electoral test after being caught requesting money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is under investigation for fraud, while attempting to frame the request as support for a film about his father. His defense contained contradictions: he initially denied the allegations, then claimed Vorcaro had no public allegations against him in 2024, but the request occurred in 2025 when Vorcaro was already under scrutiny. Film producers denied receiving any funds, raising questions about the money’s fate and undermining the candidate’s credibility among undecided voters.

item.title: Lula chamou Magro de 'grande chefe do crime organizado' e disse ter pedido prisão a Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he had requested assistance from U.S. President Donald Trump to arrest and deport Brazilian businessman Ricardo Magro, owner of Refit, whom he described as 'one of the biggest heads of organized crime in the country' and the nation's largest debtor. Lula said he had sent Trump a photograph of Magro's Miami home and details about operations that blocked 250 million liters of fuel linked to the company.

item.title: Operação da PF dificulta candidatura de Castro ao Senado
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) over suspicions of tax fraud, asset concealment, and illicit resource outflow abroad, involving fuel sector companies. The searches, authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, took place at his residence in Barra da Tijuca and worsen his already unviable electoral situation, following his 2030 ineligibility ruling by the TSE for abuse of power in the 2022 elections. His preemptive resignation was seen by the STF as an attempt to evade electoral sanctions, and the new police scrutiny further undermines any potential Senate bid in 2026.

item.title: Não temos nada a nos preocupar, a não ser com a perseguição, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for presidency in 2026, stated that the only concern is persecution, denying any wrongdoing in his contacts with Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. He rejected allegations of quid pro quo, said the money was fully used for production, and called for a CPI to investigate Banco Master. Flávio also denied offering advantages in return or intermediating government deals.

item.title: Flávio diz que Zema “foi precipitado” e agradece apoio de Caiado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Romeu Zema for being 'hasty' in judging his messages with Daniel Vorcaro, saying the former Minas Gerais governor acted prematurely without hearing his side. He thanked Ronaldo Caiado for his support, noting Caiado urged him to explain but reaffirmed the right-wing goal of defeating Lula in 2026. Bolsonaro denied any wrongdoing in the messages and said he deserved the benefit of the doubt after his clarifications.

item.title: Cidadãos lideram ações na Justiça por acesso a dados públicos
item.description: Ordinary citizens are the primary petitioners in judicial disputes over access to public information in Brazil, accounting for 55.9% of the 22,702 decisions analyzed between 2012 and 2026. Most actions stem from public administration failures, particularly administrative silence (7,549 cases), with municipalities being the most challenged entities (11,477 decisions), highlighting weak local transparency and direct civic oversight of municipal affairs.

item.title: Quem é e o que já fez deputado que comprou briga com Fábio Porchat
item.description: State Deputy Rodrigo Amorim (PL), president of the Constitution and Justice Commission of Alerj, introduced a bill to declare comedian Fábio Porchat 'persona non grata' in Rio, in response to Porchat's criticisms of Bolsonaro allies and sketches involving religion and politics. Amorim gained national prominence in 2018 for breaking the plaque honoring Marielle Franco and was one of the most voted state deputies in Rio that election. His career is marked by conservative agendas, ideological clashes, and in 2024 he became the first Brazilian parliamentarian convicted of political gender violence for remarks against transgender councilwoman Benny Briolly.

item.title: Crusoé: O ressentimento de Flávio com Zema
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) responded to criticism from former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo), saying Zema was hasty in questioning his messages to banker Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master. Flávio stated he deserved the benefit of the doubt and would never act that way toward Zema, expressing resentment over the treatment.

item.title: Flávio diz que Jair Bolsonaro o aconselhou a falar a verdade e que Eduardo vive de doação do pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, said he spoke with his father, Jair Bolsonaro, about his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, revealed by The Intercept Brasil, and that the former president advised him to stay calm and tell the truth. He also stated that his brother Eduardo lives off donations from their father. The remarks were made on Friday, May 15, 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro ainda tem muito a explicar sobre a relação com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro failed to adequately explain the use of the US$61 million transferred by Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, whose relationship was revealed in audio leaks by The Intercept. Although he claims the funds were intended for a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro, he admitted the money passed through Havengate Development Fund, a company linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro’s lawyer, Paulo Calixto, based in Texas. Repeatedly changing narratives about the money’s purpose have raised suspicions of misuse, including potential funding for Eduardo’s stay in the United States.

item.title: Esquerda comemora operação de busca e apreensão da PF contra Cláudio Castro: 'Avisei que ia acontecer'
item.description: Federal Police conducted search and seizure operations against former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) as part of an investigation into a tax evasion scheme linked to the Refit group. The operation, authorized by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, also targeted businessman Ricardo Magro, with a request for inclusion in Interpol’s Red Notice. Left-wing figures including Marcelo Freixo, Anielle Franco, Tainá de Paula, and William Siri celebrated the move on social media, linking it to corruption and political ineligibility.

item.title: Governo Lula lucrou R$ 1,85 bilhão com taxa das blusinhas
item.description: The Lula government collected R$ 1.85 billion from the so-called 'blusinhas tax' — an import duty on low-value international purchases — in the first months of 2026, according to Federal Revenue data released by CNN. Despite the significant revenue, the government decided to abolish the measure, which had become a key source of income. The tax was criticized for affecting consumers of inexpensive foreign goods, particularly from platforms like Shopee and Shein.

item.title: Flávio diz que Bolsonaro nunca se encontrou com Vorcaro, do Banco Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that former President Jair Bolsonaro never met with banker Daniel Vorcaro during negotiations to finance the film 'Dark Horse', despite documented talks. He said the funds were directed to an investment fund managed by a lawyer and that there were no irregularities, estimating the total contributions at around US$ 16 million.

item.title: Lisboa terá maior colégio eleitoral fora do Brasil
item.description: Lisbon has become the largest Brazilian overseas electoral college for the 2026 elections, with 68,979 eligible voters — a 52.4% increase since 2022. The TRE-DF oversees the voting process with consular support, and in Lisbon, voting will take place across three University of Lisbon facilities, with an initial plan for 183 sections and 87 electronic ballot boxes. Portugal also hosts voting in Porto (5th largest) and Faro, reflecting the concentration of Brazilian voters in Europe, North America, and Japan.

item.title: Flávio diz que Zema foi ‘precipitado’ em crítica sobre relação com Vorcaro: ‘Merecia o benefício da dúvida’; assista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) was 'precipitous' in criticizing him over alleged negotiations with banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. Flávio said he attempted to contact Zema and deserved the benefit of the doubt, emphasizing that funds were directed to an investment fund overseeing the film's production with no irregularities. He also praised Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) for his respectful stance.

item.title: Mário Frias contradiz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre relação com Vorcaro em filme
item.description: Federal Deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) issued a statement contradicting Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), who had admitted to maintaining a relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro linked to the financing of the film Dark Horse. Frias denied any involvement or knowledge of the alleged illicit financing, creating an internal conflict within the PL party over the matter. The disagreement arises amid investigations into potential irregularities in the use of public or private funds for film production tied to Bolsonarist figures.

item.title: Lula transfere Flávio Bolsonaro da seção política para a policial
item.description: Lula suggested that Flávio Bolsonaro, due to his toxic relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, should have his news placed in the culture section, but implied that the police section would be more appropriate given the nature of the individuals involved. The statement indirectly criticizes Flávio's conduct and his association with Vorcaro, implying their actions belong to public safety rather than cultural affairs.

item.title: Crusoé: Contaminado
item.description: The 2026 presidential election lost its predictability following the disclosure of messages between banker Daniel Vorcaro and pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. Previously, a runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was considered highly likely, but now there is uncertainty about who will face the incumbent president. Figures such as Romeu Zema and Ronaldo Caiado are emerging as potential alternatives in the political landscape.

item.title: Quantos ‘Ainda Estou Aqui’ e ‘O Agente Secreto’ seriam feitos com valor do filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro requested 131 million reais from businessman Daniel Vorcaro to fund a biopic of his father, Jair Bolsonaro. This amount exceeds the production costs of 'Still Here' (R$ 45 million) and 'The Secret Agent' (R$ 28 million), meaning the first could be made nearly three times and the second nearly five times with the same budget.

item.title: Fazenda prepara ‘agrado’ para estudantes que pagam Fies em dia apesar de sufoco financeiro
item.description: Lula's economic team is finalizing a new branch of Desenrola 2.0 targeting FIES students who are current on payments but financially strained. The initiative aims to reward those maintaining timely payments despite hardship, with significant electoral potential. Launch is expected in the first half of June and is a top priority for the Ministry of Finance.

item.title: Quem é Ricardo Magro, 'maior sonegador' de impostos do Brasil alvo de operação da PF e tema de conversa entre Lula e Trump
item.description: Brazilian businessman Ricardo Magro, owner of Refit and considered one of the country’s largest tax evaders, was targeted in Operation Sem Refinamento by the Federal Police, facing an arrest warrant and inclusion in Interpol’s red notice. His activities are linked to tax fraud schemes, money laundering, and criminal organizations in the fuel market. The case gained political relevance after Plano Planalto aides revealed that Lula intended to discuss Magro’s name in a conversation with Trump, within the framework of international cooperation against organized crime.

item.title: Vazamento 'bombástico' ameaça candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz a revista The Economist
item.description: The Economist reports that Flávio Bolsonaro’s alleged request for R$134 million from Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', with R$61 million reportedly paid, threatens his 2026 presidential bid, prompting right-wing allies to consider an alternative candidate and causing him to drop to second place in betting markets. The revelation also triggered a 2% drop in the real and the main stock index, boosting Lula’s electoral prospects. Bolsonaro denies wrongdoing, while Go Up Entertainment and screenwriter Mario Frias claim they did not access the funds, citing confidentiality agreements.

item.title: A indefinição ainda predomina
item.description: While expectations favor Flávio Bolsonaro, the 2026 Brazilian presidential election remains in an early stage and highly susceptible to sudden shifts triggered by leaks, investigations, and revelations. The analysis emphasizes that in environments of high institutional tension, voter decisions are shaped more by contingent events than by consolidated trends, urging caution against premature conclusions. Both leading candidates — Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro — face notable vulnerabilities: Lula contends with the wear of governance and the need to rebuild his base, while Flávio Bolsonaro’s circle is affected by recent controversies, including an audio leak involving Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: 51,5% desaprovam e 45,1% aprovam o governo Lula, diz Vox
item.description: A Vox Brasil Opinião poll shows 51.5% of respondents disapprove of President Lula's government, while 45.1% approve, with 3.4% undecided. Conducted between May 9–12, 2026, among 2,100 people, the survey has a 2.15-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Disapproval leads approval by 6.4 percentage points.

item.title: Parte do PL se incomoda com gestão de crise e questiona capacidade da equipe de Flávio em campanha
item.description: A faction within the PL is dissatisfied with the crisis management of Flávio Bolsonaro's communications team, led by Marcello Lopes (Marcelão), due to how it handled the leak of his conversations with Daniel Vorcaro. The team is accused of being ineffective and unprepared to confront the scandal, raising doubts about its ability to support Flávio's 2026 electoral campaign. The article is subscriber-only and highlights an internal rift in the party.

item.title: A estratégia da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro para contrato de financiamento de filme
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign came under scrutiny after leaked audio and messages revealed him pressuring banker Daniel Vorcaro to release funds for the film 'Dark Horse,' a biopic about his father Jair Bolsonaro. The issue was discussed in a campaign headquarters meeting, linking him to the Banco Master scandal. The report is exclusive to Intercept Brasil subscribers.

item.title: “Está passando de todos os limites”, diz Carlos Bolsonaro sobre Zema
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro criticized Romeu Zema for commenting on audio attributing to Flávio Bolsonaro a request for money from Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse'. Carlos said Zema 'is going beyond all limits' and accused him of hypocrisy, while Zema stressed the need for credibility in politics. The Federal Police are investigating whether Vorcaro's funds were used to cover Eduardo Bolsonaro's expenses in the U.S., though Flávio denied this, claiming the investment was private and made with expectation of financial return.

item.title: Gravação de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro impulsiona Caiado e Zema, mas não beneficia Lula: 'Eleitor olhou para o lado'
item.description: A recording involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and businessman Vorcaro led to increased negative mentions on social media, according to AP Exata, with declining trust in the politician. While this negatively affects Flávio Bolsonaro, it indirectly benefits rivals such as Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema in the 2026 election race, without advantaging President Lula, whose electorate appeared indifferent or distracted.

item.title: Investigação sobre fundo no Texas que recebeu dinheiro de Vorcaro pode esbarrar em pedido formal de cooperação com os EUA
item.description: The investigation into the Texas-based Havengate Development Fund LP, which received R$ 61 million from a company linked to Daniel Vorcaro and the film 'Dark Horse,' depends on formal Brazil-U.S. cooperation, requiring a STF investigation and judicial request to break banking secrecy. While the international route is the most structured, investigations could also advance through Brazilian-sourced testimonies and documents. Brazil-U.S. cooperation in such matters is considered fluid, but the process involves bureaucratic steps via the STF, DRCI, and DOJ, with a final decision by a U.S. federal judge.

item.title: Deputado produtor de filme sobre Bolsonaro atua para conter desgaste de áudio de Flávio e Vorcaro em missão no Bahrein
item.description: Deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP), executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse' honoring Jair Bolsonaro, traveled to Bahrain on an official mission to mitigate the political fallout from an audio leak in which Flávio Bolsonaro requested funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the movie. The audio, revealed by The Intercept, shows additional payment requests for the film, which has already received R$62 million in transfers, with Master not appearing as a formal sponsor. Despite being abroad, Frias acted remotely to contain damage to Flávio’s presidential candidacy, while Eduardo Bolsonaro is also present in the country.

item.title: Como saber se é preciso atualizar o título de eleitor em 2026 e como fazer sem sair de casa?
item.description: The electoral self-service system allows voters to check their voter registration status, request updates, and track requests online without leaving home. To determine if an update is needed for the 2026 elections, users can visit the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) website and verify if there are pending issues, such as address changes or outdated data. The service is available 24/7 and free of charge.

item.title: Master: parlamentares da base e da oposição buscam controle de narrativa com ações na Justiça após áudio de Flávio para Vorcaro
item.description: The audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro requested R$134 million from Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro triggered a wave of judicial actions by opposition and allied lawmakers. The PT, PSOL, and deputies like Henrique Vieira and Lindbergh Farias filed criminal complaints with the PGR and PF, demanding investigation and possible arrest. Meanwhile, allied deputy Hélio Lopes sought to trace leaks in the STF and TSE, aiming to control the narrative around ongoing investigations.

item.title: Após vazamento de áudio entre Vorcaro e Flávio Bolsonaro, André Mendonça marca reunião de alinhamento com PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça will hold an alignment meeting with the Federal Police regarding Operation Compliance Zero, investigating alleged fraud at Banco Master. The meeting follows the leak of audio between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, in which the senator allegedly demanded payment for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Deputy Hélio Lopes also filed motions with the STF and TSE requesting investigation into leaks of confidential investigation data.

item.title: CPI do Master não interessa à cúpula do Congresso; apesar de apoio público, governo e oposição não querem comissão
item.description: Congress leaders, including Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and Chamber President Hugo Motta, signaled they will not create a parliamentary inquiry into the Banco Master case, despite public pressure from both government and opposition. Lawmakers admit the push for a CPI serves electoral and self-protection purposes rather than genuine investigation, fearing it could implicate many politicians across the spectrum.

item.title: ‘Penduricalhos’ na mira de Lula: governo prepara projeto para regulamentar verbas indenizatórias em todos os Poderes
item.description: The Lula government is preparing a bill to regulate indemnity payments ('penduricalhos') across all branches and levels of government, aiming to cap payments that exceed the R$ 46,300 monthly salary ceiling, in line with a Supreme Court decision. The proposal splits benefits into two categories: one allowed outside the cap (such as vacation and 13th salary) and another subject to a yet-to-be-defined limit — either per benefit or aggregated. The issue is politically sensitive, affecting mainly the Judiciary, Public Ministry, and Public Defenderies, although fewer than 1% of federal executive branch servants currently earn above the ceiling.

item.title: Eduardo nega ter recebido dinheiro de fundo ligado a Vorcaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denied receiving money from the Havengate Development Fund LP linked to Daniel Vorcaro, stating his U.S. immigration status would not allow such receipt and that he had explained the origin of his funds to U.S. authorities without issue. Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed Vorcaro's investment in the film 'Dark Horse' but denied the funds were used to finance Eduardo in the U.S.

item.title: Em meio à crise por ligação com Vorcaro, Flávio mantém encontros na Faria Lima e com a 'nata do PIB' em SP
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) continues his pre-campaign agenda in São Paulo, attending events with federal deputy Guilherme Derrite and governor Tarcísio de Freitas in Campinas and Sorocaba, as well as meetings on Faria Lima with financial and tourism business leaders. Despite allegations linking him to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, he denies wrongdoing, stating he sought only private funding for a film about his father. Allies say he is positioning himself as more moderate and restrained than his father, avoiding jokes and emphasizing pro-business themes.

item.title: Caco Ciocler resgata meme do 'patriota do caminhão' em filme como diretor: 'dei risada, mas depois achei triste'
item.description: Caco Ciocler directs the film 'Eu não te ouço', based on the 'truck patriot' incident in Pernambuco after the 2022 presidential election runoff. The hybrid fiction-documentary reflects on Brazil's societal breakdown in listening, using the truck windshield as a metaphor for the inability to hear opposing political sides.

item.title: Desgaste de Flávio e versões desencontradas sobre repasses de Vorcaro despertam 'viuvez de Tarcísio' no Centrão
item.description: The scandal involving audio between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro has damaged his presidential campaign and revived discomfort within the Centrão, rekindling the 'widowhood of Tarcísio' as a more competitive alternative. Leaders from Republicanos, União Brasil and PP urge caution, refraining from explicit support for Flávio until the case's developments clarify, noting five months remain until the October elections for reassessment.

item.title: Com crise de credibilidade de Flávio mapeada, pré-campanha de Lula vai explorar contradições do senador na relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Lula's pre-campaign aims to exploit contradictions in Flávio Bolsonaro's relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, following leaked audio and messages showing the senator requested private funding for a film about his father's 2018 presidential campaign, despite previously denying any significant ties. This inconsistency reinforces existing voter perceptions of Flávio Bolsonaro's lack of credibility, identified in internal Lula campaign research, and will be a central theme in the opposition's electoral strategy.

item.title: PF rastreia caminho do dinheiro de Vorcaro para filme sobre Bolsonaro nos EUA; veja o que se sabe
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating whether money requested by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro was used to fund the stay of former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro in the United States. Suspicions arose after audio and messages between the parties were made public, revealing conflicting accounts about the funds' destination.

item.title: TSE já proibiu exibição de filme sobre Bolsonaro durante eleições
item.description: The TSE may ban the screening of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, if released in September, one month before the 2026 presidential elections, due to concerns over irregular financing. The film received R$61 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro, articulated by Flávio Bolsonaro, PL pre-candidate and senator from RJ. The article is subscriber-only and highlights the risk of undue influence in the electoral campaign.
